UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES] SET DESCRIPTION='DESCRIPTION 123' 
WHERE CODE='215' AND H = 'D'  AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE';


DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
WHERE CODE='201' AND H = 'D'  AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20240705','20240708');


INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
(
	  H
	,[Bank_Code]
	,[Source_System]
	,[Data_Mart_Field]
	,[BM_Field_Name]
	,[Code]
	,[Description]
	,[FILE_NAME]
	,[insert_dttm]
)
SELECT 
	'D' H
	,[Bank_Code]
	,[Source_System]
	,[Data_Mart_Field]
	,[BM_Field_Name]
	,'999999' [Code]
	,[Description]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]  WHERE CODE='215' AND H = 'D'  AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE';
